main.description: One visitor's call on who won a real bsky thread exchange between two accounts that have both opted in (net.bisks.elopt.optin). rkey is deterministic from the two subjects (order-independent) and the thread, so re-voting the same matchup in the same thread overwrites in place rather than stuffing extra votes. Written and read by elopt (https://elopt.bisks.net).

subjectA.description: DID of one of the two accounts battling. Order carries no meaning — see winner.

subjectB.description: DID of the other account battling.

winner.description: The voter's pick for who won this exchange — must equal subjectA or subjectB. A vote is only ever cast for a winner; there is no draw record.

thread.description: at:// URI of the thread root this vote is about — the real exchange the voter watched to make this call.

createdAt.description: When this vote was last written, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
